# Scabiosa atropurpurea L.

First published in Sp. Pl.: 100 (1753)

This species is accepted

The native range of this species is Azores, S. Europe. It is a biennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome. It is has environmental uses and as a medicine.

## Distribution

  *   * KBD

### Native to:

Albania, Algeria, Azores, Baleares, Bulgaria, Canary Is., Corse, East Aegean Is., France, Greece, Italy, Kriti, Madeira, Morocco, NW. Balkan Pen., Portugal, Sardegna, Sicilia, Spain, Tunisia, Türkiye, Türkiye-in-Europe

### Introduced into:

Argentina Northeast, Argentina Northwest, Brazil South, California, Chile Central, Chile North, Chile South, Ecuador, Germany, Great Britain, Juan Fernández Is., Kansas, Maine, Massachusetts, Oregon, Tasmania, Texas, Uruguay, Washington
